BUILT FROM THE SHARDED SWEEP (run 33219871278) AND PROVEN BY THE GRAIN DESK SWEEP, run 90042308698, 2026-08-29 00:03 UTC. discover.mjs watched https://borderag.coop/ call this endpoint; the gd sweep then read the board itself: 93 offer(s) across 6 destination(s) [Bottineau, Westhope, Lansford, Russell, Kramer, Souris], commodities Wheat, HRW 12 %, Wheat, HRS 14%, Soybeans, Flax, Corn, Canola. locationId IS THE DESTINATION STRING VERBATIM, as the payload spells it. lib/adapters/graindesk.mjs sets every row's locationId to o.destination, and filterLocation() in lib/parse.mjs compares by exact string equality with no trim and no case fold. A null here would match zero rows and refuse the source. The Barchart directory has no facility for this destination, so operator and state come from the parent record and nothing else has been derived. See _pending. FOREIGNQUOTE ADDED 2026-08-29 after the first live poll: two rows on this board are labelled "Price X2 for CWT" — the operator saying the figure is per hundredweight and must be doubled — while the futures quote beside them is not. cash minus basis came out 82,486 cents from the quote at all six Border Ag towns. Those rows are withheld rather than published, and they do not take the other 12 to 16 rows down with them.

LOCATED (2026-10-09): By matching two licence lists, not from a single row naming Russell with a ZIP. The USDA warehouse list (fixtures/registry-wcmd-grain.csv, data/registries.json) licenses Border Ag & Energy at six Bottineau County sites: Bottineau, Kramer, Lansford, RUSSELL, Souris and Westhope. The North Dakota licence list (debug/registries/https-lars-ndda-nd-gov-public-alllicenses-4.html) licenses the same company at six Bottineau County sites: Bottineau 58318, Kramer 58748, Lansford 58750, Newburg 58762, Souris 58783 and Westhope 58793. Five names match one to one, and so do the six destinations on this board; Russell has no post office of its own, so its licence is filed under Newburg, ZIP 58762. Only the ZIP is set.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.

NO COORDINATE, AND NONE WILL BE INVENTED. "Russell" is the destination string off their own board. data/known-elevators.json has no facility matching it under this operator, so address, zip, lat, lon and phone are null rather than borrowed from the parent record - borrowing would put this destination's pin on another town. Whether "Russell" is a town at all is unverified: on some boards it is the operator's own label for a facility.

cashRounding is NOT set and must not be guessed. It is measured from a real board against real futures, the way sources/chsfarmersalliance-mitchell.json records. Expect the first live poll to refuse if this board floors or rounds to the cent; that refusal IS the measurement.

bands are the DEFAULT_BANDS values for corn, soybean and wheat, copied from lib/board.mjs. They are sanity floors, not a claim about what this elevator trades. Anything else on their board falls through to DEFAULT_BANDS by substring.

THE TWO CWT ROWS ARE WITHHELD, NOT SOLVED. Border Ag genuinely bids on them and this system cannot prove those numbers, so it does not publish them. If somebody establishes the unit and the contract behind "Price X2 for CWT", they become publishable.
